Structure: Sections and divs as real Etch elements with classes, never raw HTML pasted into a block
Type Tokens: ACSS text tokens — var(--text-l, 20px) with a px or em fallback
Do: Build the element tree through the etchwp-pro skill so it validates and persists correctly
Do Not: Never emit a Custom HTML block. Never use clamp() for font size

Structure: Bricks elements with global classes; sections contain containers contain blocks
Type Tokens: ACSS text tokens where ACSS is active, otherwise Bricks typography settings
Colour Tokens: Bricks colour palette entries or ACSS variables
Spacing: ACSS space tokens or Bricks spacing controls
Do: Assign global classes rather than element-level styling so the site stays editable
Do Not: Do not style inline on elements; it fragments the design system

Structure: Containers (flexbox) with widgets — not the legacy section/column pair
Type Tokens: Elementor global typography where set, else theme fonts
Colour Tokens: Elementor global colours — Primary, Secondary, Text, Accent
Do: Use Global Colours and Global Fonts so a later change reaches every page
Do Not: Do not use the legacy section/column structure for new pages

Structure: Row layout blocks containing columns containing content blocks, styled through attributes keyed by uniqueID
Type Tokens: Kadence typography attributes, or theme.json sizes
Colour Tokens: Kadence palette colours from Global Settings
Do: Go through the kadence-pro skill so uniqueIDs and nesting validate
Do Not: Do not write raw HTML into post content

Structure: Core blocks — group, columns, cover, heading, paragraph, buttons, image
Colour Tokens: theme.json palette colours, referenced by slug
Do: Reference theme.json slugs rather than hex values so the site's own settings win
Do Not: Do not inline hex colours or px font sizes into block attributes

Structure: Not a builder — a token layer that any of the above can use
Colour Tokens: var(--primary), var(--secondary), var(--accent), the neutral ramp
Do: When ACSS is active its variables are the site's design system — read them and build to them
Do Not: Do not invent new custom properties that duplicate ACSS tokens
